notes: Implementation lane for the VM_v1_2/PageBacked_v1 plan. Landed the corrected AddressSpace BTreeMap range-index staging core via ecf3361, then added mmap-style map_script gap placement, disjoint-only mremap_script request surfaces, PageBacked-owned PageCacheIndex/PageContainer anonymous materialization, and a test-callable VM fault resolve seam over authoritative recipes. The lane now integrates cap/zone evidence plus real VM pmap publication: AddressSpace and PageContainer have zone-backed constructors and registered zones; VM recipes store VmBacking::Page { pc: Cap<PageContainer>, offset }; PageContainer uses interior synchronized state; page-cache entries store real PPN plus CachePin; fault materialization returns MapPin evidence; and AddressSpace owns a VmPmap that creates a HAL PmapRoot/ASID, captures root-local PmapIf ops, commits page faults through HAL reserve/commit, preserves a VM shadow map for MapPin ownership, and tears down mappings through HAL unmap plus ASID-scoped shootdown before releasing pins. Next step: connect file/device PageContainer paths through VFS FsPageBacking, then integrate trap/process/runtime fault dispatch. Blockers/deferred work: persistent epoch recipe snapshots, trap dispatch integration, Process/ThreadRuntime ownership, and VFS/ext4 backing integration.
